name: Domain Generation Algorithms

control.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service

evidence.rationale: DNS filtering services may block or sinkhole known and predicted algorithmically generated domains, for example those that have high entropy in the name.

Network intrusion prevention solutions can block traffic to domains or patterns associated with known domain-generation algorithms when those indicators can be identified in advance or during network activity.
DNS filtering and sinkholing can block domains generated by known domain-generation algorithms when those domains or generation patterns can be identified.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS data is version 5.6.0, the legacy ATLAS file. It is not the current ATLAS release (v2026.10 on 2026-11-08). An empty mitigation list means that ATLAS 5.6.0 links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
